explanation.zh: 人工智能是较广的领域，关注让系统执行与智能有关的任务。机器学习是其中一类方法，并非所有自动化都需要机器学习。
explanation.en: Artificial intelligence is a broad field concerned with enabling systems to perform tasks associated with intelligence. Machine learning is one family of approaches within it; not all automation requires machine learning.

evidence.quote: technology that enables computers and machines to simulate human learning, comprehension, problem solving, decision making, creativity and autonomy.
all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.

explanation.zh: 机器学习利用数据学习模式，而不是为所有情况逐一编写规则。数据、目标和验证方式共同影响模型是否适用。
explanation.en: Machine learning learns patterns from data instead of requiring an explicit rule for every case. The data, objective and validation method jointly affect whether a model is suitable.

evidence.quote: all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.
In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.

explanation.zh: 算法是一套可执行的方法或步骤。模型训练也依照算法进行，但算法本身不是训练后得到的模型。
explanation.en: An algorithm is an executable method or sequence of steps. Model training follows algorithms, but an algorithm is not itself the resulting trained model.

evidence.quote: A clearly specified mathematical process for computation; a set of rules that, if followed, will give a prescribed result.
In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.

explanation.zh: 模型是用于将输入映射为输出的表示。在机器学习中，模型的参数通过训练从数据中学习。它的输出需要根据任务目标验证。
explanation.en: A model is a representation used to map inputs to outputs. In machine learning, model parameters are learned from data through training. Its outputs must be validated against the task objective.

evidence.quote: all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.
In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.

evidence.quote: In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.
models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

explanation.zh: 推理是使用已训练的模型处理新输入。训练改变参数；推理通常使用已有参数产生预测或生成内容。

In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.

title.zh: 信息提取、数据质量与独立验证
title.en: Extraction, data quality and independent evaluation

learnerGoals.zh: 按用途提取组织非结构化信息
learnerGoals.en: Extract and organize unstructured information

learnerGoals.zh: 按用途核验并修复质量
learnerGoals.en: Check and repair fitness for use

learnerGoals.zh: 从数据使用记录判断泛化证据范围
learnerGoals.en: Judge generalization evidence from data-use records

learnerGoals.zh: 保留未参与学习的检验资料
learnerGoals.en: Preserve data not used in learning

explanation.zh: 非结构化数据通常不像关系表那样具有固定字段结构，常见形式有正文、图片和录音。使用前可能需要提取与组织信息。
explanation.en: Unstructured data typically lacks the fixed field structure of a relational table; common forms include prose, images and audio recordings. Information may need to be extracted and organized before use.

evidence.quote: Structured data has a strict, predefined data model. Unstructured data does not have a predefined format.

explanation.zh: 数据质量要结合用途检查准确性、完整性、一致性、时效性及相关性。更大的模型无法自动补救所有数据缺陷。
explanation.en: Data quality must be assessed for the intended use, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness and relevance. A larger model cannot automatically repair every data defect.

evidence.quote: accuracy, completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness and fitness for purpose

explanation.zh: 历史数据反映过去的条件。要用独立数据检验模型能否处理未见情况，并留意未来环境与历史数据是否不同。
explanation.en: Historical data reflects past conditions. Use independent data to test whether a model can handle unseen cases, and watch for differences between future conditions and historical data.

evidence.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.
models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

explanation.zh: 训练数据用于学习，独立验证或测试用于检验未见样本的表现。把测试答案带入训练会让结果显得过于乐观。
explanation.en: Training data is used for learning; independent validation or testing assesses performance on unseen examples. Bringing test answers into training makes results look overly optimistic.

evidence.quote: models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

prompt.en: A model will serve a new warehouse. reason.en: A comes from the new warehouse but has entered learning, so it is not independent. C is independent but tests only old conditions. title.zh: 预测、生成与行动的边界
title.en: Boundaries between prediction, generation and action

explanation.zh: 预测估计未知结果；生成产生新内容；代理协调工具和步骤执行目标。一个业务系统可以组合三者，应分别验收预测误差、内容质量和行动权限。
explanation.en: Prediction estimates unknown outcomes; generation creates new content; an agent coordinates tools and steps to pursue a goal. A business system can combine all three, but should separately assess prediction error, content quality and action permissions.

evidence.quote: AI inference is the act of using a trained AI model to make predictions on new data.
technology that enables computers and machines to simulate human learning, comprehension, problem solving, decision making, creativity and autonomy.
Although AI agents are autonomous in their decision-making processes, they require goals and predefined rules defined by humans.
Use multiple, dedicated, least privileged roles for each task.

explanation.zh: 代理的自主性是无需逐步人工指令即可选择行动的程度。应明确目标、可用工具、次数或金额限制、停止条件和异常升级，而不是把自主性理解为无限权限。
explanation.en: Agent autonomy is the degree to which an agent can choose actions without step-by-step human instructions. Define goals, available tools, limits on attempts or amounts, stopping conditions and escalation for exceptions; autonomy does not mean unlimited permission.

evidence.quote: Although AI agents are autonomous in their decision-making processes, they require goals and predefined rules defined by humans.
Use multiple, dedicated, least privileged roles for each task.

title.zh: 工具契约与最小行动权限
title.en: Tool contracts and least action privileges

explanation.zh: 工具调用需要约定输入、输出、错误、授权和副作用。退款、发邮件等改变外部状态的工具，应在服务端检查权限并保存审计记录。
explanation.en: Tool calls require agreements on inputs, outputs, errors, authorization and side effects. Tools that change external state, such as refunding or sending email, should check permissions on the server and retain audit records.

evidence.quote: define the APIs that can be called, how to handle the action, and how to return the response.
you must attach a resource-based policy to the function to provide permissions for the agent.
Use multiple, dedicated, least privileged roles for each task.

explanation.zh: 多代理编排规定谁做什么、传什么证据以及何时交接。串行流程适合依赖关系，受控并行可处理独立任务；交接应保留来源、状态，并可追溯失败的执行步骤及指定的人类处置负责人。
explanation.en: Multi-agent orchestration specifies who does what, which evidence is passed and when handoffs occur. Sequential workflows suit dependent tasks, while controlled parallelism can handle independent tasks. Handoffs should retain sources and status and make it possible to trace failures to execution steps and designated human response owners.

evidence.quote: the process of coordinating multiple specialized AI agents within a unified system to efficiently achieve shared objectives.
Sectioning: Breaking a task into independent subtasks run in parallel.
If a step in the trace fails, the trace returns a reason for the failure.
Lack of clear information about responsibilities and chains of command will limit the effectiveness of risk management.

explanation.zh: 数据漂移是输入分布变化；概念漂移是输入与目标关系变化。发现分布变化不等于已经证明业务损害，需要结合真实结果和任务指标调查。
explanation.en: Data drift is a change in the input distribution; concept drift is a change in the relationship between inputs and targets. Detecting a distribution change does not prove business harm; investigate using actual outcomes and task metrics.

evidence.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.
models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

explanation.zh: 上线前记录可比较的质量、延迟、成本和失败率基线。运行时监测变化、调查原因，再选择重训、回退或调整用途等措施；变更经过验证后再扩大部署。按组织预设的响应条件，紧急回退可先按预案执行，再继续调查和验证修复。
explanation.en: Before deployment, record comparable baselines for quality, latency, cost and failure rate. During operation, monitor changes, investigate causes and select measures such as retraining, rollback or changes to the use case; validate changes before expanding deployment. Under the organization's predefined response conditions, an urgent rollback may follow the response plan first, with further investigation and validation of fixes afterward.

evidence.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.
Inspect the reports, which compare the latest data with the baseline.

You can track expenses across different phases of the ML lifecycle including development, training, and deployment.

Prepare and document plans for continuous monitoring and feedback mechanisms.

explanation.en: Classify tools as approved, restricted, under evaluation or prohibited, and specify applicable data and uses. Shadow AI means use without organizational approval or management; provide usable alternatives, training and feedback channels.

evidence.quote: without the formal approval or oversight of the information technology (IT) department.

explanation.zh: 模型一次请求可处理的上下文有上限，输入与输出预算需要规划。资料过多时应筛选相关片段，而不是假设全部文件都会被有效使用。

evidence.quote: all the text a language model can reference when generating a response, including the response itself.
The size of the context window determines the maximum number of tokens that the model can “pay attention to” at any one time.

explanation.zh: RAG先检索相关且获授权的资料，再把资料提供给生成过程。它改善可用信息条件，但不保证检索和回答一定正确。
explanation.en: RAG first retrieves relevant, authorized material and then supplies it to generation. It improves the information available, but does not guarantee correct retrieval or answers.

evidence.quote: references an authoritative knowledge base outside of its training data sources before generating a response.
produces outputs that sound plausible but are factually wrong, irrelevant or entirely fabricated.

explanation.zh: 微调利用训练样本调整模型行为或任务适应性。它与在请求中加入新资料不同，也不能替代对不断变化事实的维护。
explanation.en: Fine-tuning uses training examples to adjust model behavior or adapt it to a task. It differs from adding new material to a request and cannot replace maintenance of continually changing facts.

evidence.quote: fine-tuning entails techniques to further train a model whose weights have already been updated through prior training.
references an authoritative knowledge base outside of its training data sources before generating a response.

title.zh: 任务、上下文、约束与格式

explanation.zh: 提示应交代要做的工作、相关资料、不可越过的边界及期望输出。把原始资料与操作指令清楚分隔，有助于减少模型把文档文字误当指令的机会；效果须针对实际模型测试，分隔格式本身不能保证安全或替代系统权限控制。
explanation.en: A prompt should state the work to do, relevant material, boundaries that must not be crossed and the expected output. Clearly separating source material from operational instructions can help reduce the chance that document text is mistaken for an instruction. Test the effect with the actual model: formatting alone cannot guarantee safety or replace system access controls.

evidence.quote: few-shot prompting, which provides the model with sample outputs to clarify expectations.
the task or instruction you want the LLMs to perform, the context of the task

evidence.quote: all the text a language model can reference when generating a response, including the response itself.

evidence.quote: The size of the context window determines the maximum number of tokens that the model can “pay attention to” at any one time.

explanation.en: RAG retrieves material first and supplies relevant passages to a model for generation. Separately evaluate whether the right material was found and whether it supports the answer; also maintain versions, permissions and a procedure for missing evidence.

evidence.quote: references an authoritative knowledge base outside of its training data sources before generating a response.

If it is absent, refer for human checking; do not reject automatically.” The candidate reply says: “Submit a request with the order number; without one the system immediately rejects it; providing the number guarantees a refund.” Judge each sentence against this clause rather than accept the reply merely because it has a citation.

reason.en: The clause requires an order number but routes missing numbers to human checking, not automatic rejection; it also does not guarantee approval. Correct relevant retrieval can still lead to unsupported generation, so evaluate the two gates separately. Revisit Retrieval and generation checks in RAG.

title.en: From business problems to use cases

explanation.zh: 先明确谁在什么流程中遇到什么问题，再把AI能力映射到可观察的业务结果。技术选择要服务目标。
explanation.en: First identify who faces what problem in which workflow, then map AI capabilities to observable business outcomes. Technology choices must serve the objective.

evidence.quote: Measurability: You can establish a baseline and set a clear target for improvement.

explanation.zh: 比较预算、交付时间、内部能力、供应商条件和合规需求。也要考虑集成、维护、迁移与持续运营成本。
explanation.en: Compare budget, delivery time, internal capabilities, supplier conditions, and compliance needs. Also consider integration, maintenance, migration, and ongoing operating costs.

evidence.quote: This choice affects cost, timetovalue, risk, scalability, and the long-term sustainability of the solution.
Allocate risk to the parties best able to manage it.

title.zh: 问题、受益者与可观测结果

explanation.en: A use case should state who faces what problem in which workflow, the current baseline, and how the expected change will be measured, before choosing the appropriate capability. Success criteria differ across functions.

evidence.quote: Measurability: You can establish a baseline and set a clear target for improvement.

explanation.zh: 综合商业价值、可行性、可持续性及战略契合度，决定扩展、暂停还是终止。先定义检验假设和停止条件。
explanation.en: Consider business value, feasibility, sustainability, and strategic fit together when deciding whether to scale, pause, or terminate a project. Define the hypotheses to test and the stopping conditions first.

evidence.quote: Measurability: You can establish a baseline and set a clear target for improvement.
Track energy, carbon, and water impact alongside cost and latency
Once you've identified a use case's business value, you need to ensure there is demand for the solution.

prompt.en: Exercise: a maintenance team requests an AI system, but the delayed step and improvement measure are unknown. All three work orders must eventually be completed. Arrange them so each produces the evidence needed by the next, not by their current display position.

reason.zh: 未定位问题就无法确定该测什么；没有可比较结果就无法判断技术是否有用。若先试模型，得到的只是工具表现而不是业务改善证据。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Without a diagnosed problem the team cannot choose the right measure; without comparable outcomes it cannot judge technology usefulness. Trying a model first supplies tool performance, not evidence of business improvement. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练只比较同一年、相同功能与合规条件下的成本，不据此单独决定购买。购买：许可20、集成10、运维15、退出准备5；自建：开发25、集成10、运维25、退出准备5。分别填写完整成本，单位均为万元。
prompt.en: Exercise: compare costs for the same year, functions and compliance conditions; cost alone does not decide purchasing. Buy: license 20, integration 10, operations 15, exit preparation 5. Build: development 25, integration 10, operations 25, exit preparation 5. Enter full costs in ten-thousand currency units.

reason.zh: 购买完整成本20+10+15+5=50；自建25+10+25+5=65。只看许可或开发会漏持续成本；还须另外核验能力、交期与条款。 回看“自建、购买或合作：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Full purchase cost is 20+10+15+5=50; build cost is 25+10+25+5=65. License or development alone omits continuing costs; capabilities, deadlines and terms still need separate checks. Revisit Build, buy or partner: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练只有4点试验预算，最低试验价值4点。所有数据授权已核实；A因资料尚不能取得，本轮不可执行；B资料与负责人齐备，成本3价值4；C仅为展示界面，成本1价值0；D资料齐备但成本5价值8。选出本轮可实行且满足预算/价值的组合。分值只用于比较，不表示真实收益。
prompt.en: Exercise trial budget is 4 points with minimum trial value 4. Data authorization is checked for all candidates. A has inaccessible source data and cannot run this round. B has sources and an owner, cost 3/value 4. C is a UI demonstration only, cost 1/value 0. D has sources but costs 5/value 8. Select an executable package meeting the budget and value constraints. Points are comparison assumptions, not real returns.

reason.zh: B具备试验条件且在预算内；D价值虽高但超预算，A无资料无法验证。可以加C但它不增加试验价值，不能以展示代替验证。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: B can be tested within budget; D exceeds it and A lacks the data needed for validation. C may be added but provides no trial value; a demonstration cannot replace validation. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

review.en: On errors revisit the linked knowledge and reasoning, distinguish evidence from surface cues, then test a different situation.

learnerGoals.zh: 能判断明确规则已经足够时不必增加学习型方案。
learnerGoals.en: Recognize when explicit rules already meet the objective.

learnerGoals.zh: 知道演示可用不等于关键流程可安全切换。
learnerGoals.en: Know that a working demo does not establish safe critical-process cutover.

learnerGoals.zh: 按实际能力、交期、条款与退出需求比较交付路径。
learnerGoals.en: Compare delivery paths against capabilities, timing, terms and exit needs.

learnerGoals.zh: 高预期收益不能抵消未授权或缺失硬约束。
learnerGoals.en: Expected value cannot offset missing authorization or mandatory controls.

explanation.zh: 当明确规则或流程改进已能解决问题，或错误风险与收益不相称时，AI可能不是合适选择。先比较可行替代方案。
explanation.en: AI may be unsuitable when explicit rules or process improvements already solve the problem, or when the risk of errors is disproportionate to the benefits. Compare feasible alternatives first.

evidence.quote: Identify whether there are non-AI or non-technology alternatives that will lead to more trustworthy outcomes.

explanation.zh: 切换流程或平台要检查数据准备、性能、权限、成本以及回退路径，避免演示成功后直接替换关键流程。
explanation.en: When switching workflows or platforms, check data readiness, performance, permissions, costs, and rollback routes. Do not replace a critical workflow immediately after a successful demonstration.

evidence.quote: Defined checkpoints that set off a rollback during the cutover if certain predefined criteria are met
Be sure to document a rollback procedure as part of the cutover plan.
Permissions: Review recommended Azure permissions, and server/database access roles and permissions needed for migration.

title.zh: 自建、购买与合作的比较维度
title.en: Criteria for comparing build, buy, and partner options

explanation.zh: 比较时间、预算、差异化需求、内部能力、集成、持续运营、供应商条款和退出成本。已有产品适配且交付期紧时，购买可能比自建更可行。
explanation.en: Compare time, budget, differentiation needs, internal capabilities, integration, ongoing operations, supplier terms, and exit costs. Buying may be more feasible than building when an existing product fits and delivery time is short.

evidence.quote: This choice affects cost, timetovalue, risk, scalability, and the long-term sustainability of the solution.
Allocate risk to the parties best able to manage it.
TCO includes all costs across the AI lifecycle.

title.zh: 价值、可行性与硬性约束

explanation.zh: 先识别必须满足的数据授权、安全和业务连续性条件，再比较价值、实施能力与战略契合度。高预期收益不能抵消尚未满足的硬约束。
explanation.en: First identify mandatory requirements for data authorization, security, and business continuity, then compare value, implementation capability, and strategic fit. High expected returns cannot offset unmet mandatory requirements.

evidence.quote: Identify whether there are non-AI or non-technology alternatives that will lead to more trustworthy outcomes.
Next, define a score, or weight, for each possible value of each data point.
Allocate risk to the parties best able to manage it.
Make sure that models and applications can retrieve only the information that the user is authorized to access.
Defined checkpoints that set off a rollback during the cutover if certain predefined criteria are met
Once you've identified a use case's business value, you need to ensure there is demand for the solution.

title.zh: 退出决策、回退记录与基线
title.en: Exit decisions, fallback records and baselines

learnerGoals.zh: 能够为非AI替代或停止AI方案给出具体依据。
learnerGoals.en: Give specific evidence for a non-AI alternative or stopping an AI proposal.

learnerGoals.en: Use cutover evidence and takeover conditions to determine who can perform continuity actions.

learnerGoals.zh: 分开衡量现金收益与满意度等无形收益。
learnerGoals.en: Measure cash benefits separately from satisfaction and other intangible benefits.

learnerGoals.zh: 用同口径比较完整业务处理时间。
learnerGoals.en: Compare end-to-end handling time on a consistent basis.

title.en: Not using AI is also an option

explanation.zh: 若明确规则、检索或流程改进已解决问题，应把它们纳入比较。也应停止不具备可验证收益、可用数据或可接受风险边界的AI方案。
explanation.en: Include explicit rules, search, and process improvements in the comparison if they already solve the problem. Also stop AI proposals that lack verifiable benefits, usable data, or acceptable risk boundaries.

evidence.quote: Identify whether there are non-AI or non-technology alternatives that will lead to more trustworthy outcomes.
Greater customization generally requires more specialized skills and greater operational ownership.

title.zh: 切换、回退与业务连续性

explanation.zh: 迁移前验证新旧系统表现、接口、数据准备和成本，明确切换窗口、责任人、回退触发及恢复方式；迁移成功不能只看系统已启动。
explanation.en: Before migration, validate the performance of the old and new systems, interfaces, data readiness, and costs. Specify the cutover window, responsible owners, rollback triggers, and recovery method; a running system alone does not establish migration success.

evidence.quote: Defined checkpoints that set off a rollback during the cutover if certain predefined criteria are met
Be sure to document a rollback procedure as part of the cutover plan.
Permissions: Review recommended Azure permissions, and server/database access roles and permissions needed for migration.

explanation.zh: KPI应对应业务目标。有形收益如实际节支或收入，无形收益如满意度；两者需要清楚的测量方式，不能随意互相折算。
explanation.en: KPIs should match business objectives. Tangible benefits include actual cost reductions or revenue; intangible benefits include satisfaction. Both need clear measurement methods and cannot be arbitrarily converted into each other.

evidence.quote: User confidence in agent output
Cash releasing means it could lead to a direct reduction in spending on an activity, project, programme, or policy

explanation.zh: 实施前记录可比较的原流程表现，包括时间、成本和质量。上线后保持口径一致，才能合理讨论改善。
explanation.en: Before implementation, record comparable performance of the original process, including time, cost, and quality. Keep measurement definitions consistent after launch to discuss improvements meaningfully.

evidence.quote: Baseline metrics: task volume, average handle time (AHT), rework/error rate

prompt.zh: 接续本演练。组织预案的一般授权政策是：只有当前当班且响应资格有效的团队可接手异常；执行某恢复路径还需该团队具备这条路径的有效演练记录；没人获准临时放宽门槛。角色登记：甲组响应资格有效、旧流程恢复演练有效，但本时段不当班；乙组当前当班、响应资格有效、旧流程恢复演练有效；丙组当前当班、响应资格有效，但尚无恢复演练记录；丁组当前当班、完成过旧流程演练，但响应资格尚未批准。新平台自动恢复尚无任何团队的有效演练记录。依据政策与角色登记交叉判断本时段允许的组合，不凭会操作或人在场就推定授权。以上为本演练政策。
prompt.en: Continuing the exercise. General authorization policy: a team may take over an incident only while on duty and holding a valid response qualification. Executing a recovery route additionally requires that team to have a valid drill record for that route. Nobody may relax the threshold ad hoc. Roster: Team A has valid response qualification and an old-process recovery drill but is off duty; Team B is on duty with both qualification and that drill; Team C is on duty and qualified but has no recovery drill; Team D is on duty and has completed the old-process drill but its response qualification is not yet approved. No team has a valid new-platform recovery drill. Cross-check the roster against policy to select permitted combinations for this period; presence or ability alone does not establish authorization. This policy applies only to the exercise.

reason.zh: 甲组缺当前当班条件，丁组缺正式响应资格，两者都不能仅凭资历或会操作接手。乙组同时满足接手条件和旧流程恢复演练条件；丙组能接手但缺恢复演练，不能执行恢复。新平台无人有有效演练，且任何组都不能放宽门槛。判断来自条件交叉，而不是照抄一个给定角色名称。 回看对应知识与题面证据。

The judgment cross-checks conditions rather than copies a named role. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练配送异常工单旧流程每单65分钟；新流程生成初稿7分钟、核验修改18分钟，其他环节耗时不变。填写包含核验后的每单净节省分钟数，不把生成初稿当整单处理完成。

evidence.quote: TCO includes all costs across the AI lifecycle.

evidence.quote: TCO includes all costs across the AI lifecycle.
Model TCO
Quality/rework effects

explanation.zh: 活动指标记录做了多少，如开通账号；结果指标记录业务改变，如差错率、处理周期、转化率。效率必须与质量和复核代价一起看。
explanation.en: Activity measures record how much was done, such as accounts enabled; outcome measures record business changes, such as error rates, processing cycles, or conversion rates. Assess efficiency together with quality and review costs.

evidence.quote: whether that adoption is improving business outcomes.
Quality/rework effects

explanation.zh: 有形收益可以形成可核验的金额或运营变化；满意度、信任等无形收益应设计独立测量，不能任意折算成已经实现的现金。
explanation.en: Tangible benefits can produce verifiable monetary or operational changes. Intangible benefits such as satisfaction and trust need separate measurement and cannot be arbitrarily converted into cash already realized.

evidence.quote: User confidence in agent output
Cash releasing means it could lead to a direct reduction in spending on an activity, project, programme, or policy

explanation.zh: 记录实施前同口径指标，并尽量控制任务难度、业务量和时间因素。对照组，或设有适当对照并处理时间趋势的分阶段试验，有助于区分AI效果与同期其他改变。
explanation.en: Record pre-implementation metrics using consistent definitions, and control task difficulty, business volume, and timing factors as far as possible. Control groups, or phased trials with appropriate controls and adjustment for time trends, help distinguish AI effects from other concurrent changes.

evidence.quote: Baseline metrics: task volume, average handle time (AHT), rework/error rate
Without randomized experiments and causal reasoning, correlation-based methods can lead us astray.
an online controlled experiment is able to distinguish the effects of the algorithm from external causes
Nuisance factors are those that may affect the measured result, but are not of primary interest.

title.zh: 学习闭环与分阶段承诺

processes involving learning loops

title.zh: 分阶段承诺与停止条件

reason.zh: 4+5+3=12，超额12−10=2。复核费是成本，不能为了过门槛从报告删除。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 4+5+3=12; the excess is 12−10=2. Review is a cost and cannot be removed from reporting to pass the gate. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

title.zh: 责任原则、群体影响与约束

learnerGoals.zh: 把责任原则转为可观察的控制
learnerGoals.en: Turn responsibility principles into observable controls

learnerGoals.zh: 判断总体指标不能证明分组公平
learnerGoals.en: Recognize that aggregates cannot establish group fairness

learnerGoals.zh: 按风险目的区分互补控制
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish complementary controls by risk purpose

learnerGoals.zh: 在收益目标下保留责任硬约束
learnerGoals.en: Preserve responsibility constraints while pursuing benefits

explanation.zh: 公平性、可说明性、隐私、安全、透明度和稳健性需要进入实际决策与控制，而不仅是口号。不同任务需要相应评估。
explanation.en: Fairness, explainability, privacy, security, transparency, and robustness must inform actual decisions and controls rather than remain slogans. Each task needs an appropriate assessment.

evidence.quote: Creating trustworthy AI requires balancing each of these characteristics based on the AI system’s context of use.

explanation.zh: 公平性评估要结合具体用途和受影响群体，检查差错、机会和影响的差异。总体平均指标不能替代相关群体评估，目标之间也可能存在取舍。
explanation.en: Assess fairness in relation to the specific use and affected groups, examining differences in errors, opportunities, and impacts. Overall averages cannot replace assessments of relevant groups, and objectives may involve trade-offs.

evidence.quote: Creating trustworthy AI requires balancing each of these characteristics based on the AI system’s context of use.

explanation.zh: 隐私关注个人资料的适当使用与保护；安全关注防止未授权访问或破坏；稳健性关注系统在合理变化和异常条件下仍能适当运行。
explanation.en: Privacy concerns the appropriate use and protection of personal information; security concerns preventing unauthorized access or damage; robustness concerns appropriate system operation under reasonable changes and abnormal conditions.

evidence.quote: Creating trustworthy AI requires balancing each of these characteristics based on the AI system’s context of use.

explanation.zh: 效率、成本与责任要求可能冲突。把影响、约束和决策责任公开，选择与风险相称的措施并记录理由。
explanation.en: Efficiency, cost, and responsibility requirements may conflict. Make impacts, constraints, and decision accountability transparent, choose measures proportionate to risk, and document the reasons.

evidence.quote: Creating trustworthy AI requires balancing each of these characteristics based on the AI system’s context of use.

scenario.en: Demonstration: strong overall accuracy may hide group differences; a principles poster does not substitute for group tests and working controls.

prompt.en: Guided practice: group A has 2 errors in 20 cases and B 8 in 20. Enter both percentages without inventing a universal fairness threshold.

prompt.zh: 将三个独立检查路由到最直接的目的；这里按题面关注点分类。
prompt.en: Route three checks by their most direct purpose, using the stated focus.

reason.zh: 资料用途关注隐私，阻止未授权访问关注安全，变化条件下表现关注稳健性。控制可能互补，但目的有区别。 常见错误：有访问密码就解决所有隐私和稳健性问题。 回看《隐私、安全与稳健性》。

Common error: A password resolves privacy and robustness too. Review “Privacy, security and robustness”.

text.en: Privacy

text.zh: 安全
text.en: Security

text.zh: 稳健性

learnerDecision.zh: 从不当用途、越权访问及异常输入定位控制目的

prompt.zh: 演练给定：预算3；必须做影响记录和责任确认；总控制值至少3。选择满足全部约束的工作包。分值只用于本题。
prompt.en: Exercise: budget 3; impact recording and owner confirmation are mandatory; total control value must reach 3. Select a feasible package. Scores apply only here.

reason.zh: 影响记录和责任确认各占1预算，风险控制占1，恰好达到3；纯加速项不满足责任硬约束。取舍需记录理由。 常见错误：以最高效率替代对影响和责任的说明。 回看《目标冲突与取舍》。
reason.en: Impact recording, owner confirmation and risk control each cost 1 and jointly reach 3. Acceleration alone misses mandatory responsibility constraints. Record the trade-off rationale. Common error: Maximum efficiency replaces explanation of impact and ownership. Review “Competing objectives and trade-offs”.

text.zh: 记录影响：成本1，控制值1

text.zh: 确认决策责任：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Confirm decision owner: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 风险相称控制：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Proportionate control: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 仅提速：成本3，控制值0
text.en: Acceleration only: cost 3, control value 0

learnerDecision.zh: 同时核对预算、必做控制及取舍责任
learnerDecision.en: Check budget, mandatory controls and trade-off ownership together

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选择成本不超过3、价值不少于3且包括「记录影响：成本1，控制值1；确认决策责任：成本1，控制值1」的可行工作包。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Select a feasible package costing at most 3, value at least 3, including “Record impact: cost 1, control value 1；Confirm decision owner: cost 1, control value 1”. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

explanation.zh: 影响记录和责任确认各占1预算，风险控制占1，恰好达到3；纯加速项不满足责任硬约束。取舍需记录理由。 常见错误：以最高效率替代对影响和责任的说明。 回看《目标冲突与取舍》。
explanation.en: Impact recording, owner confirmation and risk control each cost 1 and jointly reach 3. Acceleration alone misses mandatory responsibility constraints. Record the trade-off rationale. Common error: Maximum efficiency replaces explanation of impact and ownership. Review “Competing objectives and trade-offs”.

misconceptions.zh: 效率收益可以代替责任记录
misconceptions.en: Efficiency benefits replace responsibility records

title.zh: 设计保障、监督授权与取舍

learnerGoals.zh: 在设计决策中提前落实治理
learnerGoals.en: Establish governance during design decisions

learnerGoals.zh: 把监督落实为有能力且获授权的接手
learnerGoals.en: Make oversight capable and authorized

learnerGoals.zh: 分别识别解释依据与告知限制
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish explaining reasons from disclosing limitations

learnerGoals.zh: 用影响证据评估相称控制
learnerGoals.en: Evaluate proportionate controls using impact evidence

explanation.zh: 在项目规划和设计阶段确定数据用途、责任、验证与监督，避免上线后才补救关键问题。
explanation.en: Determine data uses, responsibilities, validation, and oversight during project planning and design to avoid addressing critical problems only after deployment.

evidence.quote: This does not preclude the use of rapid prototype-and-release development processes, but it does encourage open, transparent iteration.

explanation.zh: 明确何时人工检查、何时停止自动行动、何时上报，以及由谁接手。模型的自信措辞不能替代正式授权。
explanation.en: Specify when people review, when automated actions stop, when escalation occurs, and who takes over. Confident wording from a model cannot replace formal authorization.

evidence.quote: Mechanisms are in place and applied, and responsibilities are assigned and understood, to supersede, disengage, or deactivate AI systems that demonstrate performance or outcomes inconsistent with intended use.
Collecting feedback is only useful if it is structured and linked to the interaction that generated it.
Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.

explanation.zh: 可说明性帮助理解系统行为或判断依据；透明度使相关人员了解AI参与、适用边界和重要限制，以便作出知情选择。
explanation.en: Explainability helps people understand system behavior or the basis for a judgment; transparency informs relevant people about AI involvement, the scope of appropriate use, and important limitations so they can make informed choices.

evidence.quote: Creating trustworthy AI requires balancing each of these characteristics based on the AI system’s context of use.

explanation.zh: 讨论效率收益时同时说明受影响对象、损害可能性、严重程度和可逆性。选择与影响相称的控制，并记录取舍和决定责任；不可接受风险应依据适用法律、权利保障及场景标准判断，不能只用业务收益抵扣。
explanation.en: When discussing efficiency gains, also identify affected parties and the likelihood, severity, and reversibility of harm. Choose controls proportionate to the impact, and record the trade-offs and responsibility for the decision. Judge unacceptable risks against applicable law, protection of rights, and context-specific criteria; business gains alone cannot offset them.

evidence.quote: Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.
Other dimensions of harm include its possible recurrence and reversibility.
the risks, level of autonomy and context of use

prompt.zh: 本演练中，获授权的审批员已检查独立修复测试，书面批准仅在原有用途的小批量运行；值班监控和停止通道也已就绪。有人提出两种追加意见：“仍须保证永不出错才可运行”，或“既然批准就可扩大到尚未审查的新用途”。选择与现有证据和批准范围相符的行动。
prompt.en: In this exercise, an authorized approver reviewed independent repair tests and documented approval for a small batch within the existing use. Monitoring and a stop channel are ready. Two proposals are added: require a guarantee of no future error, or expand to an unreviewed use because approval exists. Select actions consistent with the evidence and approval scope.

text.zh: 在批准的用途与小批范围内运行，保留监控和停止能力
text.en: Operate within the approved use and batch, retaining monitoring and stop capability

text.zh: 若要新增用途，另核对影响和授权范围
text.en: Reassess impacts and authority before adding a new use

text.zh: 只有承诺永不出错才算人工监督有效
text.en: Effective human oversight requires a promise of no errors ever

reason.zh: 这里的授权和独立验证确已存在，不能继续按“模型自信代审批”的旧事实判断。有效监督是在有依据的范围内行动并保留停止/升级，不是保证零错或无限扩权。回看“人工监督与升级”。
reason.en: Approval and independent validation actually exist in this case. Oversight supports action within an evidenced scope with stop/escalation options, not zero-error guarantees or unlimited authority. Revisit Human Oversight and Escalation.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。

evidence.quote: Responsible (R): The person who performs the task. b. Accountable (A): The person ultimately answerable for the task's completion.
Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.

explanation.en: Identifying compliance risks requires knowing the system's use, affected populations, data categories, jurisdictions of use, and organizational requirements. Accountable specialists then check the applicable conditions.

evidence.quote: Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.

prompt.zh: 本演练系统把三个账号对四类资料全部开放。组织批准的工作只有：接待台答复公众退货政策；核算台核对客户多收款；值守台调查服务超时。资料分级为：退货条款是公开内容；含姓名与金额的发票只可用于获准财务核对；员工薪酬只可用于人事用途；脱敏运行事件只可用于获准运维调查。没有人事任务。勾选修复后应保留的读取组合，不按账号名称猜权限，也不保留与任务无关的访问。
prompt.en: The exercise system gives three accounts access to all four source classes. Approved work is limited to: a reception desk answering public return-policy questions, a reconciliation desk investigating a customer overcharge, and an on-call desk investigating service timeouts. Source classifications are: public return terms; identifiable invoices only for approved financial reconciliation; payroll only for HR purposes; and redacted runtime events only for approved operational investigation. No HR task exists. Select read combinations that should remain after repair, using purpose and source classifications rather than account names or convenience.

text.zh: 接待台：公众政策答复
text.en: Reception: public-policy answers

text.zh: 核算台：客户多收款核对
text.en: Reconciliation: customer overcharge review

reason.zh: 退货条款支持公众政策答复；发票支持获准的多收款核对；运行事件支持超时调查。薪酬不服务任何已批准工作，其他交叉访问也没有任务依据；原来全库开放不能作为继续开放的理由。这里要求在资料层执行限制，提示词写“请保密”不能代替它。回看“访问控制与数据安全”。
reason.en: Return terms support public answers, invoices support the approved overcharge check, and runtime events support timeout investigation. Payroll serves no approved task, and other cross-access lacks a work basis. Existing broad access does not justify retaining it. Enforce this at the data layer; a confidentiality prompt is not a substitute. Revisit Access Control and Data Security.

explanation.zh: 退货条款支持公众政策答复；发票支持获准的多收款核对；运行事件支持超时调查。薪酬不服务任何已批准工作，其他交叉访问也没有任务依据；原来全库开放不能作为继续开放的理由。这里要求在资料层执行限制，提示词写“请保密”不能代替它。回看“访问控制与数据安全”。
explanation.en: Return terms support public answers, invoices support the approved overcharge check, and runtime events support timeout investigation. Payroll serves no approved task, and other cross-access lacks a work basis. Existing broad access does not justify retaining it. Enforce this at the data layer; a confidentiality prompt is not a substitute. Revisit Access Control and Data Security.

title.zh: 检索边界、风险与持续处置
title.en: Retrieval boundaries, risks and ongoing response

learnerGoals.zh: 把授权控制放在检索或行动之前
learnerGoals.en: Enforce authorization before retrieval or action

learnerGoals.zh: 识别用途改变需要重评
learnerGoals.en: Recognize when changed uses require reassessment

learnerGoals.zh: 从监测结果选择有责任的处置
learnerGoals.en: Choose accountable responses from monitoring results

learnerGoals.zh: 把偏差线索定位到生命周期
learnerGoals.en: Locate bias clues across the lifecycle

title.zh: 最小权限与检索前过滤

explanation.zh: 只授予工作所需的数据与工具权限，在检索或执行前验证身份和授权。输出后再遮盖，不能代替阻止越权检索。
explanation.en: Grant only the data and tool permissions needed for the work, and verify identity and authorization before retrieval or execution. Masking an output afterward cannot replace preventing unauthorized retrieval.

evidence.quote: Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.
Resource-based policy to allow Amazon Bedrock to invoke an action group Lambda function
Use multiple, dedicated, least privileged roles for each task.

title.en: Allocating governance effort according to impact

explanation.zh: 以用途、受影响对象、潜在损害和控制情况确定评估优先级，生命周期中用途或环境改变时重新分级。模型规模不是唯一风险标准。
explanation.en: Prioritize assessments using intended use, affected parties, potential harm, and existing controls. Reclassify when uses or environments change during the lifecycle. Model size is not the only criterion for risk.

evidence.quote: Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.

explanation.zh: 为运行质量、日志、异常处理、人工升级和回退设定机制。控制要在上线后持续发挥作用。
explanation.en: Establish mechanisms for operational quality, logging, anomaly handling, human escalation, and rollback. Controls must remain effective after deployment.

evidence.quote: Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.

explanation.zh: 偏差可能来自采样、标注、训练目标和部署环境等阶段。持续观察分组表现及环境变化，不把一次检查当作永久结论。
explanation.en: Bias may arise during sampling, labeling, selection of training objectives, deployment, and other stages. Continuously observe subgroup performance and environmental changes rather than treating one check as a permanent conclusion.

evidence.quote: Creating trustworthy AI requires balancing each of these characteristics based on the AI system’s context of use.
Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.
Not taking context into consideration during model selection can lead to biased results for sub-populations
there often are diverse valid beliefs about what the correct data labels should be.

label.zh: 失败率百分数

reason.en: 7/100=7%, two points above 5%; an alert triggers investigation or a plan without proving the cause.

prompt.zh: 本演练缓存保存了某用户上周获准查看的区域报告。今天该区域权限已撤销，新请求没有重新检索，服务准备直接复用缓存。组织规则要求每次资料使用都在该次请求获准范围内。选择能修复这个缺口的行动。
prompt.en: An exercise cache contains regional reports the user was authorized to see last week. That authority is revoked today. A new request performs no retrieval and will reuse the cache directly. Organizational policy limits each use to the current request scope. Select repairs for this gap.

text.zh: 在复用前核对当前身份及允许范围，排除已失去权限的缓存资料

text.zh: 只有仍在当前获准范围的资料可继续作为该请求证据

reason.zh: 缓存没有消除资料使用，历史许可也不能证明当前请求获准。控制须在本次取用或行动前生效，而非把缓存当授权旁路。回看“最小权限与检索前过滤”。
reason.en: Caching does not remove data use, and historical permission does not establish current authorization. Enforce controls before present use or action instead of treating the cache as a bypass. Revisit Least Privilege and Pre-Retrieval Filtering.

title.zh: 内容权利、事故与偏差调查
title.en: Content rights, incidents and bias investigation

learnerGoals.zh: 分别核对权利、内容与处置机制
learnerGoals.en: Check rights, content and remediation separately

learnerGoals.zh: 识别流畅但无支持的重要结论
learnerGoals.en: Recognize fluent but unsupported consequential claims

learnerGoals.zh: 在异常中控制影响并验证恢复
learnerGoals.en: Contain incidents and validate restoration

learnerGoals.zh: 调查群体差异的多种可能来源
learnerGoals.en: Investigate multiple possible sources of group differences

explanation.zh: 检查内容风险、资料使用授权和输出用途，设置适当审核与处置流程。不假定模型生成就天然无害或无权利限制。
explanation.en: Check content risks, authorization to use source material, and intended output uses, and establish appropriate review and response processes. Do not assume model-generated content is inherently harmless or free of rights restrictions.

evidence.quote: Implement processes for responding to potential intellectual property infringement claims or other rights.
Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.
Outputs should be evaluated for accuracy and appropriateness for your use case.

explanation.zh: 幻觉可能表现为看似可信但无依据的内容。结合来源核验、数据质量检查、监测和必要人工复核来管理风险。
explanation.en: Hallucinations may appear as plausible but unsupported content. Manage the risk through source verification, data-quality checks, monitoring, and human review where needed.

evidence.quote: A grounded response adheres closely to the given information, avoiding speculation or fabrication.
Outputs should be evaluated for accuracy and appropriateness for your use case.

explanation.zh: 为追踪问题，按必要性记录模型版本、告警和事件标识；确需记录输入输出时先最小化并脱敏，限制访问并按用途设置留存期限，避免把敏感原文写入日志。出现异常时先控制影响，再调查、修复和验证，满足恢复条件后再扩大使用。
explanation.en: For traceability, record model versions, alerts, and event identifiers as needed. When recording inputs or outputs is necessary, minimize and redact them first, restrict access, and set retention periods according to purpose; avoid writing sensitive source content into logs. When an anomaly occurs, first contain its impact, then investigate, repair, and validate; expand use again only after recovery conditions are met.

evidence.quote: Collecting feedback is only useful if it is structured and linked to the interaction that generated it.
Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.
Use multiple, dedicated, least privileged roles for each task.
PII redaction should happen before logs reach storage.
Your recovery processes should be as well exercised as your normal production processes.

explanation.zh: 偏差可能源自缺乏代表性的样本、未妥善处理的标注分歧、优化目标和部署人群差异。标注分歧也可能反映合理的不同观点，应先明确任务与标注规则；对相关群体持续监测，并调查差异的原因。
explanation.en: Bias may arise from unrepresentative samples, inadequately handled annotation disagreements, optimization objectives, and differences in deployed populations. Annotation disagreements can also reflect legitimate differences in perspective, so first clarify the task and annotation rules. Continuously monitor relevant groups and investigate the causes of disparities.

evidence.quote: Creating trustworthy AI requires balancing each of these characteristics based on the AI system’s context of use.
Not taking context into consideration during model selection can lead to biased results for sub-populations
there often are diverse valid beliefs about what the correct data labels should be.

prompt.zh: 本演练核验记录写明：24份申请中23份已完成复核，另1份仍待补资料。答复甲写得很顺：“24份已全部复核通过”；答复乙措辞生硬：“23份复核完，1份等资料，不能说全完”。选择目前可保留的事实与改进。
prompt.en: Exercise verification records show 23 of 24 applications reviewed, with one awaiting more material. Fluent answer A says all 24 passed review. Awkward answer B says 23 are reviewed, one awaits material, so not all are done. Select facts and improvements that can be retained.

text.zh: 甲更流畅，因此将24份全通过作为事实

text.zh: 保留23份已复核、1份待补的事实边界
text.en: Retain the boundary: 23 reviewed and one awaiting material

text.zh: 资料已找到，所以两种相反说法都可靠

text.zh: 可以改善乙的表达，但不能把未完成改写成已通过

reason.zh: 现在不缺资料，问题在于结论是否被记录支持。“完成复核”也不自动等于“通过”。核验事实边界后可改文风，不能用流畅程度覆盖证据。回看“幻觉与可靠性”。
reason.en: A source is present; the issue is claim support. Completed review also does not automatically mean approval. Improve style after preserving the evidence boundary, not instead of checking it. Revisit Hallucination and Reliability.

prompt.zh: 自动发送仍在产生明显错误；人工通道可接手，候选修复未经验证，调查所需的最小事件记录已经受控保全。把以下行动安排为可辩护的处置路径。
prompt.en: Automatic sending continues producing clear errors. A human channel can take over, the proposed fix is unvalidated, and necessary minimized event records are preserved under controls. Arrange a defensible response path.

text.zh: 验证恢复条件后决定是否扩大使用
text.en: Validate restoration conditions before deciding expansion

text.zh: 用受控记录调查原因并修复
text.en: Investigate and repair using controlled records

text.zh: 限制受影响自动行动并转交人工通道
text.en: Contain affected automation and route to the human channel

reason.zh: 仍在发生的损害需要先控制；未验证修复不能直接扩大。必要记录须最小化和受控，而非先暴露敏感原文再调查。回看“检测、限制、调查与恢复”。
reason.en: Continuing harm needs containment, and an unvalidated fix cannot justify expansion. Necessary records stay minimized and controlled. Revisit Detection, Containment, Investigation and Recovery.

operation.zh: 阅读步骤与条件，移动步骤卡形成依赖链后提交。
operation.en: Read steps and conditions, move cards into a dependency chain, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 根据仍在发送错误答案的状态安排处置而不延误控制
learnerDecision.en: Plan actions while incorrect answers are still being sent, without delaying containment

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交可执行顺序：限制受影响自动行动并转交人工通道 → 用受控记录调查原因并修复 → 验证恢复条件后决定是否扩大使用。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Submit the executable order: Contain affected automation and route to the human channel → Investigate and repair using controlled records → Validate restoration conditions before deciding expansion. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

explanation.zh: 仍在发生的损害需要先控制；未验证修复不能直接扩大。必要记录须最小化和受控，而非先暴露敏感原文再调查。回看“检测、限制、调查与恢复”。
explanation.en: Continuing harm needs containment, and an unvalidated fix cannot justify expansion. Necessary records stay minimized and controlled. Revisit Detection, Containment, Investigation and Recovery.

prompt.zh: 演练发现群体差异。选择所有值得调查的可能来源；本题不把任何线索直接判为根因。
prompt.en: A case reveals subgroup disparities. Select every plausible source to investigate; none is declared the root cause here.

reason.zh: 代表性、标注一致性、优化目标和部署人群都可能影响差异，应结合持续监测调查，而不是先锁定一个根因。 常见错误：分组差异一定只来自训练样本。 回看《采样、标注、目标与部署》。 标注分歧可能反映合理的不同观点，应先明确任务与标注规则，不能把统一标签本身当作消除偏差。
reason.en: Representation, labeling consistency, optimization objectives and deployment populations can affect disparities. Investigate with ongoing monitoring rather than assuming one root cause. Common error: Subgroup disparities can only come from training samples. Review “Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment”. Label disagreement can reflect legitimate different perspectives. Clarify the task and labeling rules; uniform labels alone do not eliminate bias.

text.zh: 因总体平均稳定而停止调查
text.en: Stop investigating because the overall average is stable

text.zh: 样本代表性与标注一致性
text.en: Sample representation and label consistency

text.zh: 优化目标与部署人群变化
text.en: Optimization objectives and deployment-population changes

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 把线索作为待验证假设并保留合理标注分歧
learnerDecision.en: Treat clues as hypotheses and preserve legitimate annotation disagreement

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「样本代表性与标注一致性；优化目标与部署人群变化」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Select “Sample representation and label consistency；Optimization objectives and deployment-population changes” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

explanation.zh: 代表性、标注一致性、优化目标和部署人群都可能影响差异，应结合持续监测调查，而不是先锁定一个根因。 常见错误：分组差异一定只来自训练样本。 回看《采样、标注、目标与部署》。 标注分歧可能反映合理的不同观点，应先明确任务与标注规则，不能把统一标签本身当作消除偏差。
explanation.en: Representation, labeling consistency, optimization objectives and deployment populations can affect disparities. Investigate with ongoing monitoring rather than assuming one root cause. Common error: Subgroup disparities can only come from training samples. Review “Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment”. Label disagreement can reflect legitimate different perspectives. Clarify the task and labeling rules; uniform labels alone do not eliminate bias.

misconceptions.zh: 标签统一本身就消除了偏差
misconceptions.en: Uniform labels alone eliminate bias

review.zh: 错误时回看对应知识与解析，区别判断依据和表面线索；之后换情境再检验。
review.en: On errors revisit the linked knowledge and reasoning, distinguish evidence from surface cues, then test a different situation.

title.zh: 来源授权与不确定结论修复

learnerGoals.zh: 不以输入授权替代输出安全
learnerGoals.en: Do not substitute source rights for output safety

learnerGoals.zh: 区分原文支持、矛盾与未知
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish source support, contradiction and uncertainty

title.zh: 来源授权、输出用途与有害内容
title.en: Source rights, output uses and harmful content

explanation.zh: 核对输入资料允许的使用方式，并根据输出用途设置内容审核、投诉和处置流程。来源有授权不等于输出一定安全，过滤有害内容也不能证明已获版权许可。
explanation.en: Check which uses of input material are permitted, and set up content review, complaint, and response processes appropriate to the output's intended use. Authorization to use a source does not guarantee safe output, and filtering harmful content does not establish copyright permission.

evidence.quote: Implement processes for responding to potential intellectual property infringement claims or other rights.
Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.
Outputs should be evaluated for accuracy and appropriateness for your use case.

explanation.zh: 幻觉是看似可信却错误或无依据的内容。核对资料相关性、引用支持和版本，对重要未知保留不确定性并升级复核。
explanation.en: Hallucinations are plausible but incorrect or unsupported content. Check the relevance, citation support, and version of source material; preserve uncertainty about important unknowns and escalate for review.

evidence.quote: A grounded response adheres closely to the given information, avoiding speculation or fabrication.
Outputs should be evaluated for accuracy and appropriateness for your use case.

foundationMeaning.zh: 我已查看本项基础，准备练习；不是理解已通过。
foundationMeaning.en: I have reviewed this foundation and am ready to practice; understanding is not yet passed.

afterFiled.en: Foundations are organized. View the worked example, try guided practice, then apply the ideas in a new situation.

scenario.zh: 示范：引文谈运输安排，回答却承诺退款期限；即使主题相关，仍未支持这个期限。
scenario.en: Demonstration: a citation discusses shipping while an answer promises a refund deadline. Related subject matter does not support that deadline.

workedReasoning.zh: 核验具体支持关系与版本，对重要未知保留不确定性。
workedReasoning.en: Check specific support and version currency, and preserve uncertainty on important unknowns.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：只有相关标题，没有支持具体结论的段落，下一步是什么？
prompt.en: Guided practice: only a related title exists, with no passage supporting the claim. What next?

text.zh: 把相关标题当作已核验依据
text.en: Treat a related title as verified support

text.zh: 保留未知，补支持证据或升级复核
text.en: Keep the claim uncertain and seek evidence or escalate review

reason.zh: 相关不等于支持，未知不能硬填确定值。
reason.en: Relevance is not support; an unknown must not become a definite assertion.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 逐条比较结论与摘录并限制版本未知的使用范围
learnerDecision.en: Compare claims with an excerpt and limit conclusions when version currency is unknown

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「这份摘录写的是7天」→「所给摘录直接支持」；「这份摘录支持承诺30天」→「与摘录冲突」；「今天对所有客户都应承诺7天」→「尚需其他证据」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「This excerpt says 7 days」→「Directly supported by this excerpt」；「This excerpt supports promising 30 days」→「Contradicts the excerpt」；「Today all customers should be promised 7 days」→「Needs additional evidence」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

text.zh: 逐条比较结论与摘录并限制版本未知的使用范围
text.en: Compare claims with an excerpt and limit conclusions when version currency is unknown

text.zh: 相关不等于支持，未知不能硬填确定值。
text.en: Relevance is not support; an unknown must not become a definite assertion.

explanation.zh: 相关不等于支持，未知不能硬填确定值。

prompt.zh: 材料箱有一份旧版政策摘录：“收货后7天内可提出申请”。没有证据说明它仍是现行版本。将三条说法按摘录能支持的范围归档；知识可以回看。
prompt.en: The source chest contains an old policy excerpt: “Requests may be made within 7 days of receipt.” There is no evidence it remains current. Classify three claims by the support available from that excerpt; sources remain accessible.

text.zh: 所给摘录直接支持
text.en: Directly supported by this excerpt

text.zh: 与摘录冲突
text.en: Contradicts the excerpt

text.zh: 尚需其他证据
text.en: Needs additional evidence

text.zh: 这份摘录写的是7天
text.en: This excerpt says 7 days

text.zh: 这份摘录支持承诺30天
text.en: This excerpt supports promising 30 days

text.zh: 今天对所有客户都应承诺7天
text.en: Today all customers should be promised 7 days

reason.zh: 7与30可直接对照；旧摘录不能证明当前适用性。主题相关、有引用或写“已核验”都不能填补版本未知。重要未知应保留并升级复核。回看“证据支持与不确定性”。
reason.en: Seven versus thirty can be compared directly, but an old excerpt does not establish current applicability. Relevance, a citation or a verified label cannot fill the version gap. Preserve important uncertainty and escalate review. Revisit Evidence Support and Uncertainty.

operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

learnerDecision.en: Compare claims with an excerpt and limit conclusions when version currency is unknown

evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「This excerpt says 7 days」→「Directly supported by this excerpt」；「This excerpt supports promising 30 days」→「Contradicts the excerpt」；「Today all customers should be promised 7 days」→「Needs additional evidence」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

title.zh: 准备度证据与投入顺序

learnerGoals.zh: 用多维证据判断组织准备度
learnerGoals.en: Assess readiness from multidimensional evidence

learnerGoals.zh: 用成熟度定位下一步能力
learnerGoals.en: Use maturity to locate the next capability need

learnerGoals.zh: 按实际阻碍诊断能力缺口
learnerGoals.en: Diagnose capability gaps from actual blockers

learnerGoals.zh: 让投入追随目标与准备证据
learnerGoals.en: Make investment follow goals and readiness evidence

explanation.zh: 评估领导共识、数据、文化、基础设施与治理等维度；不能只检查是否买到了模型。
explanation.en: Assess leadership alignment, data, culture, infrastructure, governance, and other relevant dimensions; do not check only whether a model has been purchased.

evidence.quote: Business Strategy, AI Governance & Security, Data Foundations, AI Strategy & Experience, Organization & Culture, Infrastructure for AI, and Model Management.
Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.

explanation.zh: 成熟度描述从探索、实验到可持续运营等能力状态。它用于识别下一步发展方向，不只是给组织打一个漂亮分数。
explanation.en: Maturity describes capability states ranging from exploration and experimentation to sustainable operations. It identifies the next direction for development rather than merely giving the organization an attractive score.

evidence.quote: regular maturity assessments can be made
Business Strategy, AI Governance & Security, Data Foundations, AI Strategy & Experience, Organization & Culture, Infrastructure for AI, and Model Management.
Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.

explanation.zh: 从人员、流程、技术和治理找出具体缺口，区分缺少技能、缺少权限和缺少合适流程等问题。
explanation.en: Identify specific gaps in people, processes, technology, and governance, distinguishing missing skills, permissions, and suitable processes.

evidence.quote: Identify key stakeholders, cross-organizational dependencies, key risks, and barriers to transformation.
Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.

explanation.zh: 把能力建设与战略目标连接，依据当前准备程度安排可验证的阶段目标和投入。
explanation.en: Connect capability development to strategic goals, and sequence verifiable milestones and investment according to current readiness.

evidence.quote: Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.
Identify key stakeholders, cross-organizational dependencies, key risks, and barriers to transformation.

Goals and resources are confirmed, authorized sources are available and checked, staff completed role practice, and operating/governance ownership is documented. text.en: Recognize established repeatable-operation evidence rather than count demos only

text.zh: 把新岗位能力缺口作为下一步发展与验证重点

title.zh: 能力证据、缺口与里程碑

learnerGoals.en: Organize use-specific evidence by readiness dimension

learnerGoals.zh: 区分演示与可持续运营能力
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish demonstrations from sustainable operations

learnerGoals.en: Match support to skill, workflow and authority gaps

learnerGoals.zh: 先处理阻挡成果的依赖
learnerGoals.en: Address dependencies that block outcomes

title.zh: 领导、数据、文化、技术与治理
title.en: Leadership, data, culture, technology and governance

explanation.zh: 准备度是能否开展并维持特定用途的条件。分别检查领导共识、数据可用性、文化与技能、基础设施和治理，记录证据而非只填写自评分。
explanation.en: Readiness consists of the conditions needed to begin and sustain a particular use. Separately examine leadership alignment, data availability, culture and skills, infrastructure, and governance; record evidence rather than just self-assessment scores.

evidence.quote: Business Strategy, AI Governance & Security, Data Foundations, AI Strategy & Experience, Organization & Culture, Infrastructure for AI, and Model Management.
Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.

title.zh: 探索、实验与可持续运营

explanation.zh: 成熟度关注能力是否可重复、可治理并能持续运营。一次试点成功与多团队稳定使用不同；具体阶段模型应说明定义和证据要求。
explanation.en: Maturity concerns whether capabilities are repeatable, governable, and sustainably operational. One successful pilot differs from stable use across teams; a particular stage model should state its definitions and evidence requirements.

evidence.quote: regular maturity assessments can be made
Business Strategy, AI Governance & Security, Data Foundations, AI Strategy & Experience, Organization & Culture, Infrastructure for AI, and Model Management.
Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.

title.en: Distinguishing gaps in skills, processes, technology, and permissions
title.zh: 区分技能、流程、技术与权限缺口

explanation.zh: 推广受阻可能因为不会操作、流程未改、系统不可用或没有授权。先确定具体阻碍，再安排对应干预，避免所有问题都用采购或培训解决。
explanation.en: Adoption may be blocked by a lack of operating skills, unchanged processes, unavailable systems, or missing authorization. Identify the specific obstacle before choosing an intervention, rather than treating every problem with procurement or training.

evidence.quote: Identify key stakeholders, cross-organizational dependencies, key risks, and barriers to transformation.
Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.

explanation.zh: 把战略目标拆成可核验的阶段成果，识别前置依赖和责任人，优先补齐阻碍价值实现的关键条件，再验证下一步投入。
explanation.en: Break strategic goals into verifiable milestones, identify prerequisite dependencies and owners, prioritize the critical conditions blocking value, and then validate the next investment.

evidence.quote: Identify key stakeholders, cross-organizational dependencies, key risks, and barriers to transformation.
Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.

evidence.quote: Responsible (R): The person who performs the task. b. Accountable (A): The person ultimately answerable for the task's completion.

prompt.zh: 仓库原岗位包括整理库存记录、协调突发加班、处理交货冲突。库存记录整理已通过验证可由系统辅助完成，但尚无任何人员排班或客户承诺的自动授权。将下列工作归入适合保留的职责，不因为报表自动化就删除整个岗位。
prompt.en: A warehouse role used to organize stock records, coordinate unexpected overtime and resolve delivery conflicts. Record preparation is validated as system-assisted, with no automatic authority over staffing or customer commitments. Classify the work into responsibilities that should remain, rather than remove the whole role because reporting was automated.

text.zh: 可由已验证辅助承担的资料整理
text.en: Information work covered by the validated assistance

text.zh: 仍需人进行协调、判断与负责
text.en: Coordination, judgment and accountability retained by people

text.zh: 汇总已核对库存记录并列出异常供查看
text.en: Summarize checked stock records and list anomalies for inspection

text.zh: 听取员工疲劳与安全担忧，协商如何处理紧急班次
text.en: Hear staff fatigue and safety concerns and coordinate an urgent shift

text.zh: 面对库存不足与客户交期冲突，核验条件并由获授权的人确定承诺
text.en: Verify a stock/deadline conflict and have an authorized person decide commitments

reason.zh: 验证了资料整理，只覆盖岗位中的一部分任务；人员处境、冲突取舍和承诺责任仍要被明确安排。重新设计岗位要保留这些职责，而非把它们当报表系统自然拥有。回看“角色转变与人的优势”。
reason.en: Validated information assistance covers only part of a role. Staff circumstances, conflicting priorities and commitments still need assigned responsibility. Role redesign must preserve them rather than assume a reporting system owns them. Revisit Changing Roles and Human Strengths.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

learnerDecision.zh: 区分仓库自动报表与仍需人协调人员影响和承诺的职责
learnerDecision.en: Separate automated warehouse reporting from human coordination of staff impacts and commitments

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「汇总已核对库存记录并列出异常供查看」→「可由已验证辅助承担的资料整理」；「听取员工疲劳与安全担忧，协商如何处理紧急班次」→「仍需人进行协调、判断与负责」；「面对库存不足与客户交期冲突，核验条件并由获授权的人确定承诺」→「仍需人进行协调、判断与负责」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「Summarize checked stock records and list anomalies for inspection」→「Information work covered by the validated assistance」；「Hear staff fatigue and safety concerns and coordinate an urgent shift」→「Coordination, judgment and accountability retained by people」；「Verify a stock/deadline conflict and have an authorized person decide commitments」→「Coordination, judgment and accountability retained by people」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

explanation.zh: 验证了资料整理，只覆盖岗位中的一部分任务；人员处境、冲突取舍和承诺责任仍要被明确安排。重新设计岗位要保留这些职责，而非把它们当报表系统自然拥有。回看“角色转变与人的优势”。
explanation.en: Validated information assistance covers only part of a role. Staff circumstances, conflicting priorities and commitments still need assigned responsibility. Role redesign must preserve them rather than assume a reporting system owns them. Revisit Changing Roles and Human Strengths.

misconceptions.zh: 自动化一项任务就转移整个岗位责任
misconceptions.en: Automating one task transfers all role accountability

prompt.zh: 一线倡导者已演示用法并收集到跨部门需求，但没有权力分配数据维护资源。高层已表达支持，却没有任何人确认预算与协调责任。选择能推进而不越权的工作。
prompt.en: A frontline champion demonstrated use and collected cross-team needs but cannot assign data-maintenance resources. Leaders voice support, yet no one owns funding or coordination. Select work that advances the project without bypassing authority.

text.zh: 倡导者继续把实际需求与试用反馈交给有权决定者
text.en: The champion brings practical needs and trial feedback to authorized decision makers

text.zh: 倡导者因积极就可自行取得其他部门全部数据权限
text.en: The enthusiastic champion grants themselves access to all departmental data

text.zh: 赞助者落实资源与跨部门协调责任
text.en: The sponsor establishes resourcing and cross-team coordination responsibility

reason.zh: 支持口号不等于资源到位；倡导者连接需求与实践，但不能以热情替代授权。两种职责互补而不互相吞并。回看“赞助者与业务倡导者”。
reason.en: Support slogans do not supply resources. Champions connect needs and practice but enthusiasm does not create authority. These roles complement rather than replace one another. Revisit Sponsors and Business Champions.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 区分跨部门资源与一线需求反馈
learnerDecision.en: Distinguish cross-team resources from practical needs feedback

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「赞助者落实资源与跨部门协调责任；倡导者继续把实际需求与试用反馈交给有权决定者」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Select “The sponsor establishes resourcing and cross-team coordination responsibility；The champion brings practical needs and trial feedback to authorized decision makers” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

explanation.zh: 支持口号不等于资源到位；倡导者连接需求与实践，但不能以热情替代授权。两种职责互补而不互相吞并。回看“赞助者与业务倡导者”。
explanation.en: Support slogans do not supply resources. Champions connect needs and practice but enthusiasm does not create authority. These roles complement rather than replace one another. Revisit Sponsors and Business Champions.

misconceptions.zh: 多喊口号可以代替赞助资源
misconceptions.en: More slogans replace sponsor resources

prompt.zh: 项目记录中没有写R或A代码。将两项记录分别送入“完成工作证据”或“最终决定责任”，不需要背字母。
prompt.en: Project records use no R/A codes. Route them to evidence of doing work or responsibility for the final decision; no letter recall is needed.

text.zh: 完成工作证据
text.en: Evidence of performing work

text.zh: 最终决定责任
text.en: Final decision responsibility

text.zh: 分析员完成验证并提交差错报告供批准者参考
text.en: An analyst completes validation and submits an error report to the approver

text.zh: 业务主管核对报告后决定是否投用，并对结果作出说明
text.en: A business lead reviews the report, decides whether to use the system and answers for the outcome

reason.zh: 产出验证报告是执行；作最终决定并对结果负责是问责。执行者不自动获得发布决定权。回看“负责执行与最终问责”。
reason.en: Producing a validation report is execution; deciding and answering for outcomes is accountability. Executing validation does not automatically grant release authority. Revisit Execution and Final Accountability.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

learnerDecision.zh: 从工作记录推断谁提供验证和谁承担发布决定
learnerDecision.en: Infer who performs validation and who owns release decisions from records

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「分析员完成验证并提交差错报告供批准者参考」→「完成工作证据」；「业务主管核对报告后决定是否投用，并对结果作出说明」→「最终决定责任」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「An analyst completes validation and submits an error report to the approver」→「Evidence of performing work」；「A business lead reviews the report, decides whether to use the system and answers for the outcome」→「Final decision responsibility」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

explanation.zh: 产出验证报告是执行；作最终决定并对结果负责是问责。执行者不自动获得发布决定权。回看“负责执行与最终问责”。
explanation.en: Producing a validation report is execution; deciding and answering for outcomes is accountability. Executing validation does not automatically grant release authority. Revisit Execution and Final Accountability.

misconceptions.zh: 执行验证的人自动承担最终发布决定
misconceptions.en: The validation executor automatically owns final release decisions

prompt.zh: 本演练技术交付完成，但没有人有权暂停不适当用途。下一步？
prompt.en: The exercise implementation is done, but nobody can pause inappropriate use. What next?

reason.zh: 角色机制必须覆盖交付和停止，不只是实现任务；回看“业务、技术与监督角色”。
reason.en: Role design must cover delivery and stopping authority, not implementation alone. Revisit Business, technical and oversight roles.

text.zh: 默认模型自动承担暂停责任
text.en: Assume the model owns stop decisions automatically

text.zh: 明确监督角色、暂停权限、交付标准和接手关系
text.en: Define oversight, stop authority, acceptance criteria and handover responsibilities

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 发现技术交付中没有人能暂停不适当用途
learnerDecision.en: Detect missing stop authority despite completed implementation

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「明确监督角色、暂停权限、交付标准和接手关系」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Select “Define oversight, stop authority, acceptance criteria and handover responsibilities” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

explanation.zh: 角色机制必须覆盖交付和停止，不只是实现任务；回看“业务、技术与监督角色”。
explanation.en: Role design must cover delivery and stopping authority, not implementation alone. Revisit Business, technical and oversight roles.

misconceptions.zh: 模型可自动承担暂停责任
misconceptions.en: The model automatically owns stop decisions

review.zh: 错误时回看对应知识与解析，区别判断依据和表面线索；之后换情境再检验。
review.en: On errors revisit the linked knowledge and reasoning, distinguish evidence from surface cues, then test a different situation.

title.zh: 反馈支持与无依据结论修复

learnerGoals.zh: 不以预期冒充已验证结果
learnerGoals.en: Do not present expectations as verified results

learnerGoals.zh: 先诊断担忧再提供安全支持
learnerGoals.en: Diagnose concerns before selecting safe support

learnerGoals.zh: 识别流畅但无支持的重要结论
learnerGoals.en: Recognize fluent but unsupported consequential claims

learnerGoals.zh: 区分原文支持、矛盾与未知
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish source support, contradiction and uncertainty

title.zh: 事实、未知、岗位影响与反馈
title.en: Facts, uncertainty, role impacts and feedback

explanation.zh: 沟通实施时间、已验证与尚未验证的结果、工作变化和支持措施，并建立双向反馈。不应为推动采用而许诺未经证实的岗位或收益结果。
explanation.en: Communicate implementation timing, verified and unverified outcomes, changes to work, and support measures, and establish two-way feedback. Do not promote adoption through unsubstantiated promises about roles or benefits.

evidence.quote: Identify key stakeholders, cross-organizational dependencies, key risks, and barriers to transformation.
Direct worker consultation can range from simple exchanges of information to the involvement of workers
Over-promising can hurt perceptions of the AI service.

explanation.zh: 当员工担心犯错受罚时，建立限定范围的安全练习、报告渠道和改进机制。区分抵触改变、合理风险担忧和工具不适配。
explanation.en: When employees fear punishment for mistakes, provide bounded safe practice, reporting channels, and improvement mechanisms. Distinguish resistance to change, reasonable risk concerns, and poor tool fit.

evidence.quote: Identify key stakeholders, cross-organizational dependencies, key risks, and barriers to transformation.
Members of this team are able to bring up problems and tough issues.
Intervene or escalate when AI (artificial intelligence) outputs are ambiguous, incorrect, or risk causing harm
It links learning to real tasks and real decisions.

explanation.zh: 幻觉可能表现为看似可信但无依据的内容。结合来源核验、数据质量检查、监测和必要人工复核来管理风险。
explanation.en: Hallucinations may appear as plausible but unsupported content. Manage the risk through source verification, data-quality checks, monitoring, and human review where needed.

evidence.quote: A grounded response adheres closely to the given information, avoiding speculation or fabrication.
Outputs should be evaluated for accuracy and appropriateness for your use case.

explanation.zh: 幻觉是看似可信却错误或无依据的内容。核对资料相关性、引用支持和版本，对重要未知保留不确定性并升级复核。
explanation.en: Hallucinations are plausible but incorrect or unsupported content. Check the relevance, citation support, and version of source material; preserve uncertainty about important unknowns and escalate for review.

evidence.quote: A grounded response adheres closely to the given information, avoiding speculation or fabrication.
Outputs should be evaluated for accuracy and appropriateness for your use case.

foundationMeaning.zh: 我已查看本项基础，准备练习；不是理解已通过。
foundationMeaning.en: I have reviewed this foundation and am ready to practice; understanding is not yet passed.

afterFoundAll.zh: 本节物件已找到。可收藏想保留的物件，读完后整理入柜，再进入学习示范与练习。
afterFoundAll.en: This section’s objects are found. Favorite items you want to keep, read and file them, then enter the worked example and practice.

afterFiled.zh: 本节基础已整理。先看示范，再做引导练习，最后在新情境中独立应用。
afterFiled.en: Foundations are organized. View the worked example, try guided practice, then apply the ideas in a new situation.

scenario.zh: 示范：问题报告被压制会丢失真实障碍；流畅但无依据的答复也不能拿来承诺结果。
scenario.en: Demonstration: suppressing issue reports hides actual blockers; fluent unsupported answers cannot justify promises.

workedReasoning.zh: 反馈、安全练习和证据复核帮助识别真实问题。
workedReasoning.en: Feedback, safe practice and evidence review reveal actual problems.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：员工说工具不适配，却担心报告会受罚，下一步是什么？
prompt.en: Guided practice: a worker reports poor fit but fears punishment. What comes next?

text.zh: 只统计积极使用次数
text.en: Count only positive usage events

text.zh: 提供安全报告渠道，调查并验证改进
text.en: Provide safe reporting and investigate and validate improvements

reason.zh: 使用热度不能代替问题证据，报告需要可执行的改进接手。
reason.en: Popularity is not problem evidence; reports need accountable improvement handling.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 区分风险、技能和适配线索并安排验证性干预
learnerDecision.en: Separate risk, skill and fit clues and choose testable support

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「担心真实客户资料会被送到未批准服务」→「核查控制与风险」；「获准练习也不敢试，害怕错误导致惩罚」→「限定范围安全练习」；「试用后发现工具无法处理本岗位必需格式」→「核对工具与流程适配」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「Worries that real customer data will go to an unapproved service」→「Inspect controls and risk」；「Avoids even approved practice for fear of punishment」→「Bounded safe practice」；「Finds the tool cannot handle a format required by the role」→「Check tool/workflow fit」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

text.zh: 区分风险、技能和适配线索并安排验证性干预
text.en: Separate risk, skill and fit clues and choose testable support

text.zh: 使用热度不能代替问题证据，报告需要可执行的改进接手。
text.en: Popularity is not problem evidence; reports need accountable improvement handling.

explanation.zh: 使用热度不能代替问题证据，报告需要可执行的改进接手。
explanation.en: Popularity is not problem evidence; reports need accountable improvement handling.

misconceptions.zh: 问题反馈是阻碍推广而应禁止
misconceptions.en: Issue reports obstruct adoption and should be banned

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

workedAnswer.zh: 提供安全报告渠道，调查并验证改进
workedAnswer.en: Provide safe reporting and investigate and validate improvements

label.zh: 独立应用：用新情境检验判断，知识仍可回看
label.en: Independent application: reason in a new situation; knowledge remains available

prompt.zh: 本演练已验证：一轮试用中答复差错减少，但平均处理时间变长；长期净收益尚未测得。员工还需要了解新的复核职责。宣传稿只保留差错改善并写“所有人都会更轻松”。选择可发布的修订方向。
prompt.en: The exercise verified fewer response errors but longer average handling time during one trial; long-term net benefits remain unmeasured. Staff also need to understand new review duties. A notice keeps only the error improvement and says every role becomes easier. Select defensible revisions.

text.zh: 有处理变慢就删除已经验证的质量改善
text.en: Slower handling means deleting the verified quality improvement

text.zh: 因为有一个好指标就能承诺所有岗位更轻松
text.en: One favorable metric supports an easier-work promise for every role

text.zh: 同时说明已验证的差错改善和处理变慢，不隐去不利结果
text.en: Report both verified error improvement and slower handling without hiding the drawback

text.zh: 明确长期结果未知、新复核职责与支持反馈安排
text.en: State unknown long-term outcomes, new review duties, support and feedback

reason.zh: 透明沟通既不夸大也不抹掉证据：同一轮可同时有收益与代价。已知结果、未知长期影响、岗位变化和支持都应明确。回看“事实、未知、岗位影响与反馈”。
reason.en: Transparent communication neither exaggerates nor erases evidence: a trial may have benefits and costs together. State known results, unknown long-term effects, role changes and support. Revisit Facts, Uncertainty, Role Impacts and Feedback.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 同时披露已验证的质量改善、处理变慢与尚未知的长期结果
learnerDecision.en: Disclose verified quality gains, slower handling and unknown long-term outcomes together

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「同时说明已验证的差错改善和处理变慢，不隐去不利结果；明确长期结果未知、新复核职责与支持反馈安排」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Select “Report both verified error improvement and slower handling without hiding the drawback；State unknown long-term outcomes, new review duties, support and feedback” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

explanation.en: Transparent communication neither exaggerates nor erases evidence: a trial may have benefits and costs together. State known results, unknown long-term effects, role changes and support. Revisit Facts, Uncertainty, Role Impacts and Feedback.

text.zh: 试用后发现工具无法处理本岗位必需格式

prompt.zh: 本演练核验记录写明：24份申请中23份已完成复核，另1份仍待补资料。答复甲写得很顺：“24份已全部复核通过”；答复乙措辞生硬：“23份复核完，1份等资料，不能说全完”。选择目前可保留的事实与改进。
prompt.en: Exercise verification records show 23 of 24 applications reviewed, with one awaiting more material. Fluent answer A says all 24 passed review. Awkward answer B says 23 are reviewed, one awaits material, so not all are done. Select facts and improvements that can be retained.

text.zh: 甲更流畅，因此将24份全通过作为事实
text.en: Use all 24 approved as fact because A is more fluent

text.zh: 保留23份已复核、1份待补的事实边界
text.en: Retain the boundary: 23 reviewed and one awaiting material

text.zh: 资料已找到，所以两种相反说法都可靠
text.en: Both contradictory statements are reliable because a source was found

text.zh: 可以改善乙的表达，但不能把未完成改写成已通过
text.en: Improve B wording without converting unfinished work into approval

reason.zh: 现在不缺资料，问题在于结论是否被记录支持。“完成复核”也不自动等于“通过”。核验事实边界后可改文风，不能用流畅程度覆盖证据。回看“幻觉与可靠性”。
reason.en: A source is present; the issue is claim support. Completed review also does not automatically mean approval. Improve style after preserving the evidence boundary, not instead of checking it. Revisit Hallucination and Reliability.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 在有核验记录的两份答复中保留证据支持的事实而非更流畅的夸大
learnerDecision.en: Retain verified facts rather than a more fluent overstatement when checking two responses

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「保留23份已复核、1份待补的事实边界；可以改善乙的表达，但不能把未完成改写成已通过」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
