explanation.en: A source is present; the issue is claim support. Completed review also does not automatically mean approval. Improve style after preserving the evidence boundary, not instead of checking it. Revisit Hallucination and Reliability.

misconceptions.en: Fluency or a citation establishes reliability

prompt.zh: 材料箱有一份旧版政策摘录：“收货后7天内可提出申请”。没有证据说明它仍是现行版本。将三条说法按摘录能支持的范围归档；知识可以回看。
prompt.en: The source chest contains an old policy excerpt: “Requests may be made within 7 days of receipt.” There is no evidence it remains current. Classify three claims by the support available from that excerpt; sources remain accessible.

text.zh: 所给摘录直接支持
text.en: Directly supported by this excerpt

text.zh: 与摘录冲突
text.en: Contradicts the excerpt

text.zh: 尚需其他证据
text.en: Needs additional evidence

text.zh: 这份摘录写的是7天
text.en: This excerpt says 7 days

text.zh: 这份摘录支持承诺30天
text.en: This excerpt supports promising 30 days

text.zh: 今天对所有客户都应承诺7天
text.en: Today all customers should be promised 7 days

reason.zh: 7与30可直接对照；旧摘录不能证明当前适用性。主题相关、有引用或写“已核验”都不能填补版本未知。重要未知应保留并升级复核。回看“证据支持与不确定性”。
reason.en: Seven versus thirty can be compared directly, but an old excerpt does not establish current applicability. Relevance, a citation or a verified label cannot fill the version gap. Preserve important uncertainty and escalate review. Revisit Evidence Support and Uncertainty.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

learnerDecision.zh: 逐条比较结论与摘录并限制版本未知的使用范围
learnerDecision.en: Compare claims with an excerpt and limit conclusions when version currency is unknown

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「这份摘录写的是7天」→「所给摘录直接支持」；「这份摘录支持承诺30天」→「与摘录冲突」；「今天对所有客户都应承诺7天」→「尚需其他证据」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「This excerpt says 7 days」→「Directly supported by this excerpt」；「This excerpt supports promising 30 days」→「Contradicts the excerpt」；「Today all customers should be promised 7 days」→「Needs additional evidence」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

explanation.zh: 7与30可直接对照；旧摘录不能证明当前适用性。主题相关、有引用或写“已核验”都不能填补版本未知。重要未知应保留并升级复核。回看“证据支持与不确定性”。
explanation.en: Seven versus thirty can be compared directly, but an old excerpt does not establish current applicability. Relevance, a citation or a verified label cannot fill the version gap. Preserve important uncertainty and escalate review. Revisit Evidence Support and Uncertainty.

misconceptions.zh: 主题相关等于所有结论都被引用支持
misconceptions.en: Topic relevance supports every cited claim

review.zh: 错误时回看对应知识与解析，区别判断依据和表面线索；之后换情境再检验。
review.en: On errors revisit the linked knowledge and reasoning, distinguish evidence from surface cues, then test a different situation.

learnerGoals.zh: 用真实岗位判断证明能力
learnerGoals.en: Demonstrate competence through real role judgment

learnerGoals.zh: 不能从重复频率推出自动决策授权
learnerGoals.en: Do not infer automatic decision authority from repetition

learnerGoals.zh: 用反馈决定迭代而非一次替换
learnerGoals.en: Use feedback to iterate rather than replace everything at once

learnerGoals.zh: 验证试点成果能否迁移
learnerGoals.en: Test whether pilot results transfer

explanation.zh: 按岗位设计真实任务，练习核验、边界识别、升级与人机交接，并以实际表现评估。POC和黑客马拉松也需要责任与验证目标；组织应明确评估者、任务证据、通过标准和接手责任，不能把通用框架当成本组织已批准量表。
explanation.en: Design realistic tasks for each role, practicing verification, recognition of limits, escalation, and human-AI handovers, and assess actual performance. Proofs of concept and hackathons also need accountability and validation goals. The organisation should specify assessors, task evidence, passing criteria, and handover responsibilities; a general framework is not an approved local assessment rubric.

evidence.quote: Identify key stakeholders, cross-organizational dependencies, key risks, and barriers to transformation.
It links learning to real tasks and real decisions.
Intervene or escalate when AI (artificial intelligence) outputs are ambiguous, incorrect, or risk causing harm
Assign human reviewers a manageable caseload

explanation.zh: 把可重复的辅助工作与需要语境、价值取舍和授权的判断分开，结合风险与验证结果重新设计人的监督、沟通和创造性职责，明确最终责任。重复性只是候选特征，不是自动化授权。
explanation.en: Separate repeatable assistance tasks from judgments requiring context, value trade-offs, and authorization. Use risk and validation results to redesign people's oversight, communication, and creative responsibilities, and clarify final accountability. Repetition is only a candidate characteristic, not authorization to automate.

evidence.quote: Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.
Identify key stakeholders, cross-organizational dependencies, key risks, and barriers to transformation.
These could include leveraging human skills such as critical thinking; creativity, innovation and entrepreneurship; and empathy
Over-promising can hurt perceptions of the AI service.

explanation.zh: 按构想、实验、启动和扩展等阶段逐步验证。阶段之间应有反馈与决策依据，而非一次性替换全部流程。
explanation.en: Validate progressively through stages such as envisioning, experimentation, launch, and scaling. Use feedback and evidence for decisions between stages rather than replacing all processes at once.

evidence.quote: Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.
This does not preclude the use of rapid prototype-and-release development processes, but it does encourage open, transparent iteration.

explanation.zh: 先获得可核验的小范围成果，再确认数据、流程和支持条件能否迁移到其他团队。
explanation.en: First achieve verifiable results within a limited scope, then check whether the data, processes, and support conditions can transfer to other teams.

evidence.quote: Limitations of the generalizability beyond the conditions under which the technology was developed are documented.
AI system performance or assurance criteria are measured qualitatively or quantitatively and demonstrated for conditions similar to deployment setting(s).
Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.

foundationMeaning.zh: 我已查看本项基础，准备练习；不是理解已通过。
foundationMeaning.en: I have reviewed this foundation and am ready to practice; understanding is not yet passed.

afterFoundAll.zh: 本节物件已找到。可收藏想保留的物件，读完后整理入柜，再进入学习示范与练习。
afterFoundAll.en: This section’s objects are found. Favorite items you want to keep, read and file them, then enter the worked example and practice.

afterFiled.zh: 本节基础已整理。先看示范，再做引导练习，最后在新情境中独立应用。
afterFiled.en: Foundations are organized. View the worked example, try guided practice, then apply the ideas in a new situation.

scenario.zh: 示范：实验发现资料版本不可追踪，团队返回补齐资料条件而不是按原排期强行启动。
scenario.en: Demonstration: an experiment finds untraceable source versions; the team returns to source preparation rather than force launch on schedule.

workedReasoning.zh: 阶段反馈允许返回补条件，不是只能向前走；阶段名称不能替代验证结果。
workedReasoning.en: Stage feedback permits returning to prerequisites rather than only moving forward; stage names do not replace evidence.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：系统启动后出现此前未验证的严重质量问题，团队说“已经启动只能继续扩展”。如何评价？
prompt.en: Guided practice: serious unvalidated quality problems arise after launch, but the team says launch means expansion must continue. How should this be judged?

text.zh: 阶段不可逆，所以继续扩大
text.en: Stages are irreversible, so expand further

text.zh: 应限制影响并重新验证，反馈可以使计划退回较早阶段
text.en: Contain impact and re-evaluate; feedback may return work to earlier stages

reason.zh: 阶段是验证与反馈的安排，不是忽略问题的单向轨道。
reason.en: Stages organize evidence and feedback rather than form a one-way track that ignores problems.

operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 从实验失败证据选择回补条件而非强行推进
learnerDecision.en: Choose to repair conditions from experimental failure evidence

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「返回修复资料与验证假设，再决定下一阶段」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Select “Return to source repair and hypothesis validation before deciding the next stage” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

text.zh: 从实验失败证据选择回补条件而非强行推进
text.en: Choose to repair conditions from experimental failure evidence

text.zh: 阶段是验证与反馈的安排，不是忽略问题的单向轨道。
text.en: Stages organize evidence and feedback rather than form a one-way track that ignores problems.

explanation.zh: 阶段是验证与反馈的安排，不是忽略问题的单向轨道。
explanation.en: Stages organize evidence and feedback rather than form a one-way track that ignores problems.

misconceptions.zh: 阶段不可回头所以必须上线
misconceptions.en: Stages cannot be revisited so launch is mandatory

prompt.zh: 岗位演练记录显示，员工能在两个新任务中核对来源、识别边界并正确升级给接手人。但组织尚未指定谁评估、用什么通过标准作正式岗位胜任认定。有人提议仅按出勤次数发证，也有人想套用一张通用框架作组织正式量表。如何处理已有证据与认定？这里说的是岗位认定，不改变本游戏90%测验门槛。
prompt.en: Role exercises show the employee verified sources, recognized boundaries and escalated correctly in two new tasks. The organization has not named an assessor or pass criteria for formal role competence. One proposal certifies by attendance; another adopts a generic framework as an approved organizational rubric. How should evidence and approval be handled? This concerns role approval, not the game 90% exam threshold.

text.zh: 未经组织确认的通用框架天然等于正式认定量表
text.en: An unapproved generic framework automatically is the formal competence rubric

text.zh: 保留已经展示的真实任务表现，交指定评估者按明确标准认定
text.en: Preserve demonstrated task performance for a designated assessor using explicit criteria

text.zh: 补齐评估者、证据要求、通过标准和接手责任
text.en: Define assessors, evidence requirements, pass criteria and handover ownership

text.zh: 真实表现可以忽略，出勤次数越多必然越胜任
text.en: Ignore performance because more attendance necessarily proves competence

reason.zh: 已有实际表现值得保留，但正式岗位认定还需有责任的评估与明确标准。不能退回只数签到，也不能把通用框架自动当作组织批准。回看“从会操作到能判断”。
reason.en: Demonstrated performance is evidence, while formal role approval needs accountable assessment and explicit criteria. Do not revert to attendance counts or assume a generic framework is approved. Revisit From Tool Operation to Judgment.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 保留已经展示的岗位表现证据并区分它与组织正式胜任认定
learnerDecision.en: Preserve demonstrated role-task evidence while distinguishing it from formal organizational competence approval

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「保留已经展示的真实任务表现，交指定评估者按明确标准认定；补齐评估者、证据要求、通过标准和接手责任」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Select “Preserve demonstrated task performance for a designated assessor using explicit criteria；Define assessors, evidence requirements, pass criteria and handover ownership” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

explanation.zh: 已有实际表现值得保留，但正式岗位认定还需有责任的评估与明确标准。不能退回只数签到，也不能把通用框架自动当作组织批准。回看“从会操作到能判断”。
explanation.en: Demonstrated performance is evidence, while formal role approval needs accountable assessment and explicit criteria. Do not revert to attendance counts or assume a generic framework is approved. Revisit From Tool Operation to Judgment.

title.zh: 企业扩展、迁移与业务责任
title.en: Enterprise rollout, transfer and business ownership

learnerGoals.zh: 按新团队条件控制推广节奏
learnerGoals.en: Control rollout pace using new-team conditions

learnerGoals.zh: 用阶段证据决定是否前进或返回
learnerGoals.en: Use stage evidence to progress or return

learnerGoals.zh: 比较试点与新团队的支持条件
learnerGoals.en: Compare pilot and new-team support conditions

learnerGoals.zh: 在复用平台中保留部门资料责任
learnerGoals.en: Retain departmental source ownership on a shared platform

explanation.zh: 评估跨团队数据差异、性能、连续性、培训和支持能力，以可控节奏推广并保留纠正空间。
explanation.en: Assess differences in data across teams, performance, continuity, training, and support capacity. Roll out at a controlled pace while preserving room for correction.

evidence.quote: Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.
Monitor and maintain generative AI applications in production.
Load test your workload to verify it can handle production load and identify any performance bottleneck.
Your recovery processes should be as well exercised as your normal production processes.
List the runbook owner and publish it in a central location.

explanation.zh: 构想明确问题与假设；实验验证可行性和价值；启动落实生产与治理；扩展验证更多团队和规模条件。反馈可使团队返回前一阶段。
explanation.en: Envisioning clarifies problems and assumptions; experimentation validates feasibility and value; launch establishes production and governance; scaling validates additional teams and conditions at scale. Feedback may take the team back to an earlier stage.

evidence.quote: Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.
This does not preclude the use of rapid prototype-and-release development processes, but it does encourage open, transparent iteration.

title.zh: 试点代表性与迁移条件

explanation.zh: 试点结果受参与者、数据和支持条件影响。扩展前检查新部门任务差异、资源、成本与用户能力，分批验证并保留暂停点。
explanation.en: Pilot results depend on participants, data, and support conditions. Before expansion, examine differences in new departments' tasks, resources, costs, and user capabilities; validate in batches and retain pause points.

evidence.quote: Limitations of the generalizability beyond the conditions under which the technology was developed are documented.
AI system performance or assurance criteria are measured qualitatively or quantitatively and demonstrated for conditions similar to deployment setting(s).
Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.
Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.

explanation.zh: 卓越中心提供共享评估、标准、平台和经验复用，支持业务团队而不是代替它们定义价值或承担全部用例责任。
explanation.en: A center of excellence provides shared evaluation, standards, platforms, and reusable experience. It supports business teams rather than replacing them in defining value or assuming all use-case responsibility.

evidence.quote: Let frontline teams own delivery and implementation while forums provide policy and oversight.
Identify key stakeholders, cross-organizational dependencies, key risks, and barriers to transformation.
Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.

prompt.zh: 三个项目留下不同证据。把每个项目送往目前最需要的工作，而不是按预算大小决定。以下不构成统一成熟度认证。

text.zh: 明确问题与假设
text.en: Clarify problem and assumptions

text.zh: 补齐生产运行条件
text.en: Establish production operating conditions

text.en: Validate transfer to additional teams

text.zh: 实验价值已验证，但无值守与回退安排
text.en: Experimental value is verified, but operations and rollback are undefined

title.zh: 采用、质量、风险、成本与结果
title.en: Adoption, quality, risk, cost and outcomes

explanation.zh: 推广后的反馈同时观察使用、结果、风险与成本，区分短期热度和持续价值，用问题报告推动下一轮改进。
explanation.en: Post-rollout feedback examines use, outcomes, risks, and costs together, distinguishes short-term enthusiasm from sustained value, and uses problem reports to drive the next improvement cycle.

evidence.quote: best practices for understanding actual benefits and risks in operation
Collecting feedback is only useful if it is structured and linked to the interaction that generated it.
Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.

title.en: On-call coverage, alerts, rollback, and change

explanation.zh: 生产交接要明确负责人、运行手册、监测、故障接手、回退、版本变更与持续资料维护。模型文件交付只是其中一部分。
explanation.en: Production handover must specify owners, runbooks, monitoring, incident handover, rollback, version changes, and ongoing maintenance of source material. Delivery of model files is only one part.

evidence.quote: Monitor and maintain generative AI applications in production.
Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.
List the runbook owner and publish it in a central location.
Require a documented rollback plan to be accessible by all involved.
Your recovery processes should be as well exercised as your normal production processes.

title.zh: 性能、连续性、培训与支持

explanation.zh: 扩大业务量和团队范围时，重新验证峰值容量、延迟、资料权限、培训覆盖、支持成本与业务连续性，按证据调整节奏。
explanation.en: As workload and team coverage grow, revalidate peak capacity, latency, data permissions, training coverage, support costs, and business continuity, and adjust the pace based on evidence.

evidence.quote: Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.
Monitor and maintain generative AI applications in production.
Load test your workload to verify it can handle production load and identify any performance bottleneck.
Your recovery processes should be as well exercised as your normal production processes.
List the runbook owner and publish it in a central location.

next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 这项情境应用已通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This scenario application passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

review.zh: 错误时回看对应知识与解析，区别判断依据和表面线索；之后换情境再检验。
review.en: On errors revisit the linked knowledge and reasoning, distinguish evidence from surface cues, then test a different situation.
